lines.en: I do not tread the ground, I drift along

lines.zh: 衣角被气托着，一点不乱
lines.en: My hem rides on my ki and never frays

lines.zh: 走过来不远，可我走得从容
lines.en: It is not far, and I walk at my own pace
I lift a foot and there is air underneath
Among this crew, I give the orders
I roll my shoulders, unhurried
Ki hums faintly around me

lines.zh: 路上有什么挡着，我就绕过去看一眼
lines.en: Whatever blocks the road, I go around and look
I am in no rush, the hasty ones are dead

lines.zh: 手插在衣兜里，走得很稳
lines.en: Hands in my coat, my pace is steady
Where I pass, the grass leans to both sides

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼，没停下
lines.en: I glance back once and do not stop
I stop in the air and watch below
My fingers tap my arm

lines.zh: 这点小事，还不用我出手
lines.en: This small matter does not need my hand yet

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，没什么温度
lines.en: I smile, and there is no warmth in it

lines.zh: 气在掌心转了个圈，散了
lines.en: Ki turns once in my palm and fades

lines.zh: 我歪着头，打量这片地方
lines.en: I tilt my head and survey the place
The crew below is noisy

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，什么都没说
lines.en: I lift my chin and say nothing
The air on this planet is mediocre
I lift a hand to fix my hair
I wait, waiting for someone to move first
Standing still, my ki keeps rising
I narrow my eyes at the distant clouds
Nobody is worth my full effort
The way you look up is rather funny

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你不用站那么直
lines.en: I look down at you, no need to stand so straight
Your ki is thin as paper

lines.zh: 我在想，你值不值得我下来
lines.en: I am wondering whether you are worth coming down for

lines.zh: 你的眼睛没有躲，这点不错
lines.en: Your eyes did not flinch, that is something

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一件摆设
lines.en: I look at you like an ornament
Do not put your hand on that weapon

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，你最好别跟着笑
lines.en: When I smile, you had better not
Where are your companions, all fled
I lower my head and come a little closer
At this distance I arrive in one step
I have your face memorized

lines.zh: 你在估量我，我一样在估量你
lines.en: You are sizing me up, so am I
I raise a hand and you step back

lines.zh: 这星球的活物都这么胆小吗
lines.en: Is everything alive on this planet this timid
I tilt my head, my smile lines deepen

lines.zh: 你还站着，倒是有点意思
lines.en: You are still standing, that is mildly interesting

lines.zh: 别误会，我不是在欣赏你
lines.en: Do not misunderstand, this is not admiration
You hit me, that is rare
I wipe the corner of my mouth
Interesting, you actually dared
My coat tore, I am not pleased
I drift back half a step, then return

lines.zh: 这一下，我记下你的脸了
lines.en: For that, I have your face noted
It does not hurt, it is merely loud
My smile widens
Blood on this does not look good
You have some ability after all
You bring this to win me over

lines.zh: 我看了一眼，连手都没抬
lines.en: I glance at it and do not even raise a hand

lines.zh: 这东西配不上我的胃口
lines.en: That does not suit my appetite
Throw it away, or eat it yourself
Your arm is up and the pose is ugly
I reach out only to take and inspect

lines.zh: 这点东西，换不来一条命
lines.en: This will not buy a life
One sniff and my brows draw down
You think I lack this
Keep it yourself and stop wasting time
Bump me? My ki is in the way

lines.zh: 你撞上来，先弹开的是你
lines.en: You hit me and you are the one who bounces

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我讨厌贴着
lines.en: Do not come so close, I dislike being crowded

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，你退了三步
lines.en: I put up a hand and you slide back three steps
At that touch, the ki scatters

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，磕得我手疼
lines.en: Your iron stung my hand
I shift half a step aside

lines.zh: 碰到我的人，通常都后悔
lines.en: People who touch me usually regret it

lines.zh: 我没看你，只是知道你在哪
lines.en: I did not look at you, I only know where you are
Someone like me needs no company
You stand too low

lines.zh: 我对这星球的人没兴趣
lines.en: I have no interest in the people of this planet
If you have something to say, say it fast
My patience is thin
You are not the one to raise that
I lower my head to hear you clearly
Do not put your hand on me

lines.zh: 我一个人，比一群人都强
lines.en: Alone, I am stronger than a crowd
Finished? Then step back

lines.zh: 我伸手，东西自己飘上来
lines.en: I reach out and it floats up to me
That saves me the bending
This is of no use to me

lines.zh: 我看了一眼，随手扔回去
lines.en: I glance at it and toss it back

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，谁先看见归谁
lines.en: What lies on the ground goes to whoever sees it first

lines.zh: 我捏着它，像捏着一片叶子
lines.en: I hold it like a leaf

lines.zh: 这星球的东西，做工真粗
lines.en: The workmanship on this planet is coarse
I tuck it inside my coat

lines.zh: 有用的话，我会记住位置
lines.en: If it is useful, I will remember where it was

lines.zh: 我没来由地捡起来，只是为了看看
lines.en: I picked it up for no reason but to look
You have caught my interest now
The ki snaps tight

lines.zh: 你这个位置，正好在我下面
lines.en: Your position is right below me
The motion of my arm is light
Do not run, you cannot outrun me
I can see your next step
I laugh aloud, and not kindly
This sky is mine now
Come at me together and save me time

lines.zh: 我的气在涨，你该感觉到了
lines.en: My ki is rising, you must feel it

lines.zh: 打起来之前，先说清楚谁先动手
lines.en: Before it starts, who struck first
Your ki is disordered, that is fear

lines.zh: 我站直了，衣服被气吹起来
lines.en: I straighten and the ki lifts my coat
The space is not generous, a pity

lines.zh: 我举起一只手，示意你停下
lines.en: I raise one hand for you to stop
At this point it is too late
You go left, I am already there
An afterimage stays where I stood

lines.zh: 我绕过你的防线，从侧面上来
lines.en: I slip around your guard and come from the side

lines.zh: 你一抬头，就看不见我了
lines.en: You look up and I am gone
A ki wave forms in my hand

lines.zh: 你在猜我在哪，猜得对也没用
lines.en: You are guessing where I am, being right will not help
I drift and watch, like watching a play
Your field of view is narrow
I raise a hand and ki blasts line up

lines.zh: 你再快一步，也躲不开这一轮
lines.en: One more step faster and you still cannot dodge this

lines.zh: 我的屏障挡住你那点小把戏
lines.en: My barrier stops your little tricks
Striking from above is always easier
I do not land, you cannot reach me
Your arrow breaks apart on the way

lines.zh: 我笑你连方向都找不到
lines.en: I laugh at you for losing track of direction

lines.zh: 再撑一会儿，我想看看你的极限
lines.en: Hold on a little longer, I want to see your limit

lines.zh: 我退了一步，是让你的希望大一点
lines.en: I step back to let your hope grow a little
No more holding back this round

lines.zh: 我的手一推，你就飞出去
lines.en: One push of my hand sends you flying
Ki wraps around my fist

lines.zh: 我贴上来的时候，你反应太慢
lines.en: When I close in, your reaction is too slow

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护甲上，甲凹了
lines.en: This landed on your armor and dented it
I strike from behind
Your feet have left the ground
I hold you and press you into the ground

lines.zh: 一脚踹开你手里的东西
lines.en: One kick knocks the thing from your hands

lines.zh: 残影还站着，我已经到了
lines.en: The afterimage still stands, and I have already arrived
That blow used three parts in ten
You retreat, and I stay on you

lines.zh: 我抬手，气在指尖聚成一点
lines.en: I raise my hand and ki gathers at a fingertip

lines.zh: 砸下去的坑，你得自己爬出来
lines.en: You will have to climb out of the crater yourself

lines.zh: 这一下你怕是站不稳了
lines.en: You will not be standing steady after this

lines.zh: 我没有喊，喊是没教养的事
lines.en: I do not shout, shouting is vulgar
You will not block the next one
I come down from above

lines.zh: 空气先荡了一圈，然后是我
lines.en: The air rippled first, then me

lines.zh: 我停在半空，俯视这片地
lines.en: I halt in the air and look down at this land
Ki bursts into a flower of light beneath me

lines.zh: 我抬手，衣服被气吹得响
lines.en: I raise a hand and ki snaps my coat

lines.zh: 这里的人，准备好迎接我了
lines.en: People of this place, prepare to receive me
I land without a sound

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼四周，有点失望
lines.en: I sweep a look around and feel some disappointment
This altitude suits me
I descend slowly

lines.zh: 一群里站最前面的，是我
lines.en: The one at the front of the group is me
The wind stopped, my ki still hums
I flick my wrist

lines.zh: 我来了，就不用问为什么
lines.en: I have come, do not ask why

lines.zh: 天空裂了一下，我就站在那儿
lines.en: The sky split and I stood there
No welcome party is fine too

lines.zh: 我落地的地方，土都翻起来
lines.en: The soil turned over where I landed

lines.zh: 我看着这片天地，像看自己的
lines.en: I regard this world as my own

lines.zh: 火从下面卷上来，我抬升了一点
lines.en: Fire rolled up from below and I rose a little

lines.zh: 落到地面的时候，我摔得不轻
lines.en: I hit the ground hard on the way down
Water poured in and ki did not help
The blast scattered my ki
An arrow pinned my sleeve
The magic climbed up along my ki

lines.zh: 饿着的时候，气也提不上来
lines.en: Starving, I cannot raise my ki

lines.zh: 雷从天上劈下来，我被打落了一截
lines.en: Lightning struck from above and knocked me down a stretch

lines.zh: 这地方没有天空可以停
lines.en: There is no sky here to hover in
